title: Walking over to join children who are already playing is listed at age 3
summary: CDC says most children notice other children and enter their play by about age 3.
body: The social milestones at 3 years include noticing other children and joining them to play. The scene is a group already underway, and the child moves into it. CDC's most means 75 percent or more. A missed item on this sheet is a prompt to talk with a doctor, not a label. The age is the one the US page prints.

sources.title: Learn the Signs. Act Early. milestone page
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports the 3-year social milestone 'Notices other children and joins them to play.' US federal page, public domain. Paraphrased, not quoted.
